## Cloud2FEM

A pipeline that converts unstructured point clouds of existing buildings into
finite element meshes ready for structural analysis.

[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/Cloud2FEMpublic){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

## C2F4DT

Cloud2FEM for Digital Twins — an environment for organising, processing and
visualising survey data alongside the models derived from it.

[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/C2F4DT){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

## FinEtools contributions

Finite element formulations for flexible structures (shells and beams) in Julia,
contributed to the `FinEtools` ecosystem.

[Repository](https://github.com/gcastellazzi/FinEtoolsFlexStructures.jl){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}
